title: Molecular geometry from held adjacency and orientation
statement: Molecular geometry is the complete relative adjacency-and-orientation form of one identified finite molecular carrier, invariant under a global rigid host-frame relabelling and separate from measured coordinate values.
generation_rule: Generate the literal product of the registered geometry carrier, adjacency, orientation, completeness, equivalence, measurement, record and extension choices.
grammar_boundary: Every finite admitted molecular carrier with a complete pairwise relative-orientation record, interpreted up to one global rigid relabelling and retained with its source and observation conditions.

choices.name: geometry-without-molecule
choices.reason: A shape detached from an identified carrier is not molecular geometry.

choices.name: identified-molecular-carrier
choices.reason: The geometry remains bound to one molecule.

choices.name: atom-list-only
choices.reason: An atom list omits which occurrences are joined.

choices.name: distance-only-record
choices.reason: Distances alone can omit handed or ordered orientation.

choices.name: held-relative-orientation
choices.reason: Each generated atom pair has a retained orientation relation.

choices.name: selected-coordinate-subset
choices.reason: A favorable subset cannot establish the whole geometry.

choices.name: complete-pair-support
choices.reason: Every generated unordered occurrence pair is recorded exactly once.

choices.name: absolute-host-frame
choices.reason: A host coordinate frame cannot define chemical identity.

choices.name: rigid-relabel-equivalence
choices.reason: One global translation/rotation/relabel leaves the relative form unchanged.

choices.name: coordinate-as-proof-premise
choices.reason: A measured coordinate cannot select the law.

choices.name: source-bounded-geometry-record
choices.reason: Coordinates and uncertainties remain post-seal empirical records.

choices.name: shape-name-only
choices.reason: A shape name cannot reproduce the relations.

choices.name: adjacency-orientation-source-trace
choices.reason: Carrier, pairs, orientations, method and conditions remain held.

choices.name: free-angle-fit
choices.reason: A fitted angle can force a target geometry.

choices.name: no-extra-rule
choices.reason: Complete relative support supplies the geometric form.

induction_base: A two-occurrence molecule has one complete relative-orientation relation.
induction_step: Appending one atomic occurrence adds every new occurrence-pair relation while preserving the complete prior adjacency and orientation trace.
exclusions: no chemical dictionary, coordinate archive, fitted force field, measured geometry or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no application or opaque prediction result
no claim that topology alone predicts every measured coordinate or energy
external content remains inaccessible until after the consequence is sealed
Every finite admitted molecular carrier with a complete pairwise relative-orientation record, interpreted up to one global rigid relabelling and retained with its source and observation conditions.
operational_witnesses: three atomic occurrences require and retain three pair relations
no absolute host coordinate enters the witness
no measured decimal selects the relative form
falsification_condition: The claim fails if the authoritative geometry record lacks identified atoms, relational spatial organization or source-bounded coordinates, or if a changed row is accepted.
